basic_info.description: Urban Elegance Meets Parkside Serenity. Welcome to 2137 Grove Street, in San Francisco's coveted North Panhandle neighborhood, where city living embraces the lush calm of Golden Gate Park. Just steps from tree-lined trails and vibrant urban cafes, this extensively renovated 2019 residence offers the perfect harmony of modern design, family comfort, and timeless luxury. From the moment you enter, you're greeted with a sense of space and flow. The sun-drenched living and dining rooms spill effortlessly onto a south-facing terrace, framing panoramic views that invite morning coffee rituals and evening gatherings under the glow of the city lights. For the culinary enthusiast, the kitchen includes a five-burner Miele range, dual Bosch dishwashers, and custom cabinetry. In-home laundry, one-car garage parking are all here to complete the package. This is more than a condoit's a lifestyle. A sanctuary for young families who crave the vibrancy of urban living while being just steps from nature's playground. 2137 Grove Street is your gateway to San Francisco living at its most inspired.
